# Date Range

## Summary
Base-realm start/end date pair. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/date-range-field` (default export
`DateRangeField`).

## API
- `start`, `end` — DateFields (serialized `YYYY-MM-DD`)

## Usage
```ts
import DateRangeField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/date-range-field';

@field bookingWindow = contains(DateRangeField);
```
Renders the two dates as a range. For a time-of-day range within a single
day, use the Time Range field instead.
